# Monster Correlation Rigidity — physical selection

Ruge Lin's project asks whether independently meaningful physical requirements select the Monster, rather than merely whether an engineered object has recognizable Monster symmetry.

The active ledger is [PHYSICS_STATUS.md](PHYSICS_STATUS.md). [STATUS_CURRENT.md](STATUS_CURRENT.md) and [STATUS.md](STATUS.md) preserve the former certification track and original import record. Circuit compilation and gate-threshold optimization are not the main research question.

## Latest: the next primary level is generated by the first

[Note13](research/13_weight_three_ope_channel.md) derives the weight-three OPE channel without assuming Monster symmetry. In the physical class of [Note12](research/12_physical_selection_from_extremality.md), the primary part of the product of two weight-two fields is

$$B(a\wedge b)=a_{(0)}b-\tfrac12L_{-1}(a_{(1)}b).$$

The subtraction includes the full stress-tensor contribution. Its positive Gram operator satisfies

$$B^\dagger B=F_-+\tfrac13I=282\Pi_+,\qquad BB^\dagger=282I_{P3}.$$

Consequently **every one of the 21296876 weight-three primaries arises from pairs of the first primary fields**. The proof uses rank of the Gram operator, not a coincidence of dimensions. Each normalized output primary has the same summed squared coupling282 to unordered input pairs.

There is an equally important limit: the channel's positivity and rank already follow from the earlier contraction spectrum. Once the unknown weight-two product is specified, this channel is fixed up to output basis, but it imposes no new restriction beyond those preceding identities. This is a derived low-weight corollary using standard VOA techniques, not full selection of the Monster or a new general Norton inequality.

## What physics has selected so far

Among nontrivial simple unitary strongly rational bosonic holomorphic chiral theories with no weight-one currents, minimize positive central charge. The criterion does not mention the Monster; it is a substantial restriction on admissible theories, not a universal physical law or an established dynamical flow.

Prior modular and conformal-design theorems then give c=24, the J spectrum, vanishing primary thermal one-point functions through weight eleven, and precise low-energy OPE contraction data. The known moonshine theory proves attainability, not uniqueness. The missing step remains identification of the complete weight-two multiplication with the Conway-Griess algebra. Neither a partition function nor a list of contraction eigenvalues establishes that step.

The [next assignment](work_orders/CURRENT.md) is the weight-four primary OPE channel, retaining all descendants and looking specifically for an additional constraint on the unknown interactions. No Monster character decomposition, known multiplication table or axis classification may be inserted to close the argument.

## Evidence

The [42-check verifier](checks/verify_weight_three.py) uses exact integer/fraction arithmetic. It computes oscillator modes in small even free-boson examples, tests all corresponding four-label Gram entries, and checks extremal scalar ranks/constants. Largest square matrix15x15; oscillator grade at most3. No full c24 OPE tensor or Monster data is constructed.

```sh
python checks/verify_weight_three.py
python -O checks/verify_weight_three.py
python -OO checks/verify_weight_three.py
# Historical evidence replay, unchanged:
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python verify.py
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python checks/replay_portability.py
```

All three new reports agree locally.
